arm.role: the sealed flight: every arm below is a column of it

aa.role: the in-flight twin: replicate_of lock, the null of every contrast

lock.role: the delivering arm: LEFT of every contrast (the locked template, untemplated)

r1-c3.role: candidate Solver instruction template (hash-pinned; the R1 c3 bytes)

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim; node-local, never a system-level claim. No utterance text, transcript, gold label or model output is printed or persisted.
decision_rule: SAME-FLIGHT NODE-TEMPLATE COLUMN READ AS THE VERDICT SOURCE OF THE VER-1 RULE (VER-1c; NX instrument E1/E2; owner decision 257, decision 258 option A proposed 2026-10-10; claim ceiling 'descriptive': the arm is NOT a nomination). One flight, one Solver visit per row of TRAIN Fold A, 3 arms over the SAME QueryState and evidence: r1-c3 (the R1 c3 template, the same hash-pinned bytes the NX R1 iteration-1 cell flew), aa (the twin, replicate_of lock) and lock (the locked template, delivering, last). Each arm's first-visit Solver answer is rendered through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train per arm (never sharded; scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --mode supply-variants writes the per-arm first-visit outputs and scores the composer reads). READS: (1) THE TWIN NULL first: aa minus lock on every metric, paired per row, whole-utterance cluster bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260915), reported beside the E1 provisional floor (SLU-F1 1.49 pp, intent 0.65 pp at n = 1,080; borrowed until a node-column cell measures its own null). (2) THE c3 COLUMN: r1-c3 minus lock, pooled SLU-F1 and intent, quoted DESCRIPTIVELY with its CI95 (it gates nothing and nominates nothing; a Fold A c3 loss or gain is information about the verdict source, not a result of this cell). (3) THE VERDICT SOURCE: the c3 presence verdict is the flag 'the r1-c3 answer carried no entity after the registered v4g normaliser' (slurp_ver1_offline.verdict_flags); the number of verdict-empty rows and of verdict-empty rows on empty-gold rows is reported beside the TRAIN Fold B figures of the NX R1 flights so that a drift of the verdict between rosters is visible. (4) THE VER-1 RULE FIXED ON SLURP-EVO-FOLD-B-V2 (support filter n = 3, s = 2; c3 verdict x N1 >= 0.2; v4g) is applied offline to the VER-1b sample pool on these rows with scripts/analysis/slurp_ver1_offline.py --verdict-run; the confirmation criterion is the VER-1b READ row's (SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VER1B-SAMPLES-FOLD-A-POOL-READ-V1). NOTHING IS TUNED OR SELECTED HERE. The delivering arm is the lock: the delivered answer is unchanged by construction at the request level (invariant I7).

fixed_rule_consumer.n1_signature: the verdict run's own phases.json (the pre-Solver exemplar entity-free share), as for the R1 iterations
fixed_rule_consumer.reads: runs/SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VER1C-C3-COLUMN-FOLD-A-V1/attempt-slurp-native-stage3-ver1c-c3-column-fold-a-generation-v1/supply-variants/arm-<arm>-first-visit-outputs.jsonl and arm-<arm>-slurp-slu-official-train-scores.json for the arms lock, aa, r1-c3

node_local.role: diagnostic: localises where an official delta comes from; gates nothing

bootstrap.unit: row (paired); the whole-utterance number is the node-local read's own

steps: 0. Refuse unless the READ row SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VER1C-C3-COLUMN-FOLD-A-COLUMN-READ-V1 is root countersigned.

1. Refuse unless the flight carries a COMPLETE sealed 1,080-row manifest with one complete official TRAIN score and the saea-supply-variant-arms-v4 receipt on every row, verified by the bundle (invariant I7v).

2. Official: render each arm's first-visit Solver answer through the delivered row's normaliser and projection and score it ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train (3 jobs, never sharded); this writes the supply-variants files the composer reads.
3. Twin null (aa vs lock) first, then the c3 column vs lock, both DESCRIPTIVE; per-scenario tables.
4. Node-local (E2 reader schema v2; DIAGNOSTIC, gates nothing).

5. Hand the column to the VER-1b confirmation read (recipe docs/readiness/2026-10-10-slurp-ver1b-samples-fold-a-v1/analysis-recipe-v1.json, --verdict-run); the verdict-empty row counts are reported beside the TRAIN Fold B figures of the NX R1 flights.
